brief: A wall-hung spice rack: at least three bins, hung from keyhole hangers.

requirements.evidence: Three open bins in a flat row with tall jar props visible from above/front show spice storage; actual wall load capacity is not rated by the configurator, only fit is verified.
Three full-depth bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:2,0,0~hex-bin-full

Two hex-acc-keyhole accessories fitted: accessory:0#0,0#1 on the left end cell and accessory:0#2,0#2 on the right end cell, both offered at slot 1 / bearing 30 so they share a back face for wall screws.

finish.summary: Built a single-row wall-hung spice rack: three full bases at 0,0 / 1,0 / 2,0, each with a full-depth bin (bin:0,0,0, bin:1,0,0, bin:2,0,0), two keyhole hanger accessories (accessory:0#0,0#1 and accessory:0#2,0#2) on matching back faces of the end cells, capped open faces, locked joints, and a tall glass jar staged in each bin to show spice-jar storage. check_build is ok with meshClash clear and no prop warnings. Note: the configurator verifies fit/collision only, not wall-screw pull-out or load rating of the printed hangers.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
